tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Lists the document pages on luckpanda.app (generators for invoices, quotes, proforma invoices, receipts and credit notes, plus country and trade templates) and its calculator pages, each with its URL. Optional filters: document_type, country, query. Read-only.

tools.name: get_document_rules
tools.description: Returns what to collect before creating a document of a given type and country: required, recommended and optional fields, the tax ID and tax names, the country's invoicing rules (for example India GST rule 46, UK VAT invoice contents), the CGST/SGST versus IGST split and state codes for India, and

tools.name: create_document_link
tools.description: Validates a document (invoice, quote, proforma invoice, receipt or credit note) and returns editor_url, a short link that opens it prefilled in the LuckPanda editor, where the person can review, edit and download the PDF. Also returns the totals with tax worked out, the required fields still missing

tools.name: create_document_pdf
tools.description: Generates a PDF of a document (invoice, quote, proforma invoice, receipt or credit note) and returns it base64-encoded in structuredContent.pdf_base64, with its verification URL and an editor_url that opens the same document in the editor. PDFs from this tool include a LuckPanda footer and a verific

tools.name: calculate_gst
tools.description: GST on an amount in rupees: add GST to an amount before tax, or take it out of an amount that includes it; CGST + SGST for a supply within one state, IGST across states. Read-only arithmetic.

tools.name: calculate_vat
tools.description: VAT on an amount: add it to a net amount or take it out of a gross one. UK by default; EU countries and the UAE by country (standard rate if no rate is given). Read-only arithmetic.

tools.name: calculate_emi
tools.description: Monthly EMI on a reducing-balance loan, total interest, total payment and the year-by-year schedule. Read-only arithmetic.

tools.name: check_gstin
tools.description: Checks that an Indian GSTIN is well formed (15 characters, state code, PAN, check character) and decodes the state and PAN. It makes no lookup and does not confirm that the registration exists or is active. Read-only.

tools.name: find_hsn_code
tools.description: Searches HSN codes (goods) and SAC codes (services) by product or service words or by code digits, with the official description, the chapter and heading it sits under, and the GST rate where it has been checked against the rate notification (otherwise rate_percent is null: check the notification).
